description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Caleb Downs practiced on Thursday.
items.impact: Downs missed practice to begin the week on Wednesday. He'll likely be listed as a limited participant on Thursday.
items.title: Caleb Downs (concussion/ankle) practices Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: P.J. Locke got in some work in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Locke remains in concussion protocol. He will likely be limited in practice.
items.title: P.J. Locke (concussion) practices Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jihaad Campbell did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Campbell continues to battle multiple injuries. His status for Sunday's game against the Giants is up in the air.
items.title: Jihaad Campbell (hamstring/quad) not practicing Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Britain Covey is not practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Covey's status is up in the air for Sunday's game against the Giants.
items.title: Britain Covey not practicing Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Dontayvion Wicks remained absent from practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Wicks is continuing to trend in the wrong direction to return for Sunday's game against the Giants.
items.title: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) not practicing Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: DeVonta Smith is not practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Smith is continuing to trend in the wrong direction to return for Sunday's game against the Giants.
items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) not practicing Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Saquon Barkley is practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Barkley is on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against his former team in the Giants. He'll remain on the RB2 radar for fantasy managers.
items.title: Saquon Barkley practicing Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bears placed RB Zavier Scott on injured reserve.
items.impact: Scott has been playing a role on special teams. He'll miss at least the next four weeks.
items.title: Zavier Scott (thumb) placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Cam Skattebo was working with trainers on the side during practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Skattebo will likely be listed as a non-participant in practice again on Thursday. His status for Week 9 is uncertain.
items.title: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) working on side with trainer in practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Deshaun Watson remained absent from practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Watson remains in concussion protocol. He is continuing to trend in the wrong direction for Sunday's game against the Saints.
items.title: Deshaun Watson (concussion) not practicing Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kyler Murray is considered week-to-week with his hamstring injury.
items.impact: Carson Wentz was named the Vikings starter for Monday's game against the Bills. Murray could become the backup for Minnesota if Wentz plays well.
items.title: Kyler Murray (hamstring) week-to-week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Malik Nabers was seen working off to the side with trainers on Thursday.
items.impact: It is unclear what Nabers is dealing with. He will need to be monitored when the injury report for Thursday is released.
items.title: Malik Nabers works off to side with trainers during practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jaylen Wright was back at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Wright remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.
items.title: Jaylen Wright (quad) returns to practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Garrett Wilson was not seen practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Wilson continues to trend in the wrong direction to play this week as he remains in concussion protocol.
items.title: Garrett Wilson (concussion) not practicing Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Breece Hall was practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Hall was limited to begin the week on Wednesday. He continues to trend towards making his return for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.title: Breece Hall (quad) practicing Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Carson Wentz will start Monday's game against the Bills.
items.impact: Kyler Murray is continuing to battle a sore hamstring. Wentz will be a QB2 for fantasy managers in 2-QB and superflex leagues.
items.title: Carson Wentz will start in Week 9 for Vikings

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bills signed CB Kader Kohou to their practice squad.
items.impact: Kohou previously spent time with the Dolphins. He'll remain in the AFC East.
items.title: Kader Kohou signs with Bills

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: KhaDarel Hodge is expected to be available for Sunday's game against the Raiders.
items.impact: The 49ers are still expected to be without Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel. It will be Hodge, Demarcus Robinson, Christian Kirk, Jordan Watkins, and Brandin Cooks leading the wide receiver room for San Francisco.
items.title: KhaDarel Hodge expected to be available Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Demarcus Robinson is expected to be available for Sunday's game against the Raiders.
items.impact: The 49ers are still expected to be without Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel. Robinson, Christian Kirk, Jordan Watkins, and Brandin Cooks will lead the 49ers wide receiver room.
items.title: Demarcus Robinson (ankle) expected to play Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: DJ Turner II was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Turner will be good to go for Sunday's game against the Falcons.
items.title: DJ Turner II (heel) logs full practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: 49ers GM John Lynch said it's unlikely that Deebo Samuel Sr. will play in Week 9 against the Raiders.
items.impact: Mike Evans is also not expected to play. Demarcus Robinson, Christian Kirk, Jordan Watkins, and Brandin Cooks will lead the 49ers wide receiver room.
items.title: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) not expected to return in Week 9

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: 49ers GM John Lynch said it's unlikely that Mike Evans will play in Week 9 against the Raiders.
items.impact: Deebo Samuel is also not expected to play. Demarcus Robinson, Christian Kirk, Jordan Watkins, and Brandin Cooks will lead the 49ers wide receiver room.
items.title: Mike Evans (Achilles) not expected to return in Week 9

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Brian Robinson Jr. remained limited in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Robinson was also limited on Wednesday. He is trending towards having a chance to return this week for the Falcons.
items.title: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) limited in practice Thursday
